title: Labcorp Announces 2026 Second Quarter Results; Raises Full Year 2026 Guidance
publisher: Labcorp Holdings Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 3.73 billion, adjusted EPS was USD 4.99, and full-year adjusted-EPS guidance was raised to USD 18.10-18.55.
summary: Rechecked the SEC-hosted Q2 release; its retained hash is unchanged and still supports growth, margin expansion and raised guidance alongside high debt and weaker quarterly cash conversion.
